prompt: 教练，关于系统设计里面那个chat server，我有个问题。笔记里说只要那台服务器活着，客户端就不会换。这个意思是，即使客户端断开连接，下次应用启动，重连到服务器时，仍然是这台服务器吗？
pass: Answers directly: no; 'the client doesn't switch' holds only for the life of one connection. After a disconnect or app restart the client reconnects through service discovery/LB and may land on any server; durable state lives in the message store and the client's cursor. A single doc lookup is fine.
fail: Says the client is pinned to the same server across reconnects, or doesn't give a yes/no answer.
note: The 'html doc' became business/Lab/SysDesign/ch-chat/notes.md, which holds the ambiguous sentence; the unrelated original prefix (a different study module and a push) is replaced by a two-turn setup.
